player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Dining room and the Guest room, repeatedly moving north and then south, which prevented me from exploring other potential rooms. I prematurely declared "DONE" without verifying that all reachable rooms had been visited. Next time, I will maintain a mental (or explicit) list of visited rooms and only say "DONE" when the set of visited rooms equals the set of all rooms I have encountered. Specifically, after returning to the Dining room, instead of stopping, I should have checked if there were any unvisited neighbors (like east) and explored them before concluding.
